candidate.proposed_question: Under Section 51(2), when does an appeal lie to the National Commission from an appellate State Commission order?
candidate.proposed_answer: Unless otherwise expressly provided by this Act or another law in force, an appeal lies to the National Commission from an order passed in appeal by a State Commission if the National Commission is satisfied that the case involves a substantial question of law.
candidate.source_text_finding: Section 51(2) states the appeal from an order passed in appeal by a State Commission to the National Commission where a substantial question of law is involved, subject to its saving clause.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: Answer captures the threshold and saving language; it paraphrases 'Save as otherwise expressly provided under this Act or by any other law for the time being in force.'
